body:
this is a side effect of #7833, the tables now include views which seems to be unexpected in this case.
/cc @nineinchnick

@cebe I'm looking at the `Schema` sources and can't figure out the best solution to this. We can't add arguments to `getTableNames()` and can't modify its return type. `TableSchema` could contain an extra property with its type but I'd prefer to avoid an extra query in `getTableSchema()`. Those are expensive for example in Oracle.

I guess we could add another method like `getViewNames()` to filter them out in `checkIntegrity()` but it would be confusing for `getTableNames()` to also include views.
we can have it this way in 2.0.x and clean it up in 2.1.

issue.title: InitDbFixture pgsql problem

repository.name: yii2
repository.description: Yii 2: The Fast, Secure and Professional PHP Framework

issue.body: When TestCase setup the DbFixtures check the integrity, for that, get all the table names, and execute a command like this `ALTER TABLE "public"."auth_assignment" DISABLE TRIGGER ALL;` is a problem, because the method `findTableNames` [https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/db/pgsql/Schema.php](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/db/pgsql/Schema.php) get all the objects names (including the views), them, when execute the statement for check integrity fail.

body: Any easy way to workaround this issue? Thanks.

@ricpelo this would be the way:

> I guess we could add another method like getViewNames() to filter them out in checkIntegrity() but it would be confusing for getTableNames() to also include views.
Could somebody share quick fix for this problem, please?

I have the same error, a temporary solution, since I do not use views,  I remove 'v' of findTableName() method(file pgsql/Schema.php) like that:

```
        $sql = <<<SQL
SELECT c.relname AS table_name
FROM pg_class c
INNER JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE ns.nspname = :schemaName AND c.relkind IN ('r','m','f')
ORDER BY c.relname
SQL;
```
I wonder if it could be easier to fix the issue in the fixture/load module instead of Schema.php.
